title: A blog and changelog for what's new
summary: New features now get a post with samples you can open and change, and every update goes in the changelog.

body.text: Endless Patterns now has this blog and a [changelog](/changelog/). The changelog is the short list of what changed and when. Blog posts are for bigger additions, with examples you can try.
Samples you can open and change
Each sample in a post is a link into the matching tool, with the same settings already filled in. Open one, then change the size, colors or gauge to make it your own.

items.caption: Bear's Paw, nine 14" blocks with sashing

title: Knitting and crochet stitch patterns, sized to your gauge
summary: Pick a stitch, enter your size and gauge, and get a starting count, written rows, a chart and a yarn estimate.

body.text: There are now 9 [knitting stitches](/knitting/) and 7 [crochet stitches](/crochet/). Each page works out your project from your own gauge, so the numbers fit the yarn and tools you're using.

items: Stitches to cast on, or chains to start, rounded to whole pattern repeats
Row-by-row instructions, with crochet in US terms
A stitch chart and a printable PDF

items.caption: 2x2 Rib, set up as an 8" x 60" scarf
V-Stitch, set up as a baby blanket

body.text: The starting gauge for each yarn weight is only a typical value, and the yarn figure is a rough estimate. Work a 4" swatch, enter what you measure, and buy some extra yarn. [How the calculations work](/about/) explains the assumptions.

title: Build a quilt from 36 traditional blocks
summary: Set a block's size, colors and layout, then get a cutting list, yardage, seamless repeats and printable templates.

body.text: The [quilt block builder](/blocks/) covers 36 traditional blocks, from a simple [Nine Patch](/blocks/nine-patch/) to curved and appliquéd designs. Choose any finished size from 3" to 24", set your colors and lay out a whole quilt.

items.caption: Ohio Star in barn red, with sashing
Dresden Plate, appliquéd to a background

items: A cutting list for one block or the whole quilt
Yardage for each fabric, plus backing, binding and batting
SVG and PNG downloads, including a seamless repeat
A PDF with piecing steps and true-size templates

body.text: When a size falls between ruler marks, the builder rounds the cut up, says so, and suggests the nearest sizes that divide evenly. Check the figures before you buy or cut.
